root_cause: The CPU plugin's MVN primitive selection on ARM64 non-deterministically falls back to a generic (undef_f32) implementation instead of picking the ACL (Arm Compute Library) acl_f32 kernel for this particular shape/config combination. This is the same known flaky ACL primitive-selection pattern seen 5 prior times on unrelated PRs (signature eb0b94c864ee1a85), confirming it is unrelated to the current PR's change (a null-check fix in the NPUW MoE topology code, unrelated to CPU/ACL kernel selection).
reproduction_steps: Run on an ARM64 runner: ./ov_cpu_func_tests --gtest_filter=*smoke_CompareWithRefs_Mvn3D/MvnLayerCPUTest.CompareWithRefs*IS=[1..5.1..20.1..7]*AcrossChannels=TRUE_NormalizeVariance=TRUE* repeatedly; the primType selection in cpu_test_utils.cpp:248 is known to intermittently resolve to undef_f32 instead of acl_f32 on this platform.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed CPU functional tests job (it is a known flaky ARM64/ACL primitive-selection issue, not caused by this PR's change)
File/bump a tracking ticket for the underlying ACL primitive-selection flakiness in src/plugins/intel_cpu for MVN layer tests on ARM64
Investigate whether the ACL executor factory for MVN has a race or config-dependent fallback path causing non-deterministic primType selection
prevention_strategies: Add a retry/known-flaky marker for ARM64 ACL-backed CPU functional tests until the underlying primitive-selection non-determinism is fixed, and track recurrence via the rerun_search_string 'primType is unexpected' already approved in the workflow rerunner.
historical_context: This exact signature has now occurred 6 times (first seen 2026-09-11, most recently in this run), across 6 different unrelated PRs (#37783, #37885, #38052, #38528, #38669, #39245), always with 'primType is unexpected' + 'undef_f32 Expected : acl_f32' on ARM64 CPU functional test jobs. The rerun_search_string 'primType is unexpected' is already approved in .github/scripts/workflow_rerun/errors_to_look_for.json, so the automated rerunner should already retry these when it matches the log.
